[FACT] The user is interested in making homemade salsa.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a recipe for spicy homemade salsa with fresh tomatoes, including ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant listed the ingredients for the salsa: 5-6 large tomatoes, 1 red onion, 1-2 jalapeno peppers, 1-2 garlic cloves, 1 lime, 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt and pepper to taste, and a handful of fresh cilantro.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided detailed instructions for making the salsa, including washing, cutting, broiling, blending, and chilling the ingredients.  
[USER] The user expressed that the recipe sounds easy enough.  
[USER] The user asked if the salsa can be made ahead of time and stored in the fridge.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant confirmed that the salsa can be made ahead of time and stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a week.  
[USER] The user inquired about using other types of peppers instead of jalapenos.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant stated that other types of peppers can be used, suggesting milder peppers like Anaheim or poblano for less spice, and hotter peppers like serrano or habanero for more spice.  
[USER] The user mentioned a preference for adding avocado to salsa and asked if it would work well with the recipe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant agreed that adding avocado would be a great idea, suggesting to dice it and add it to the blended salsa or pulse it for a chunkier texture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant cautioned that avocado will cause the salsa to turn brown over time, recommending to use it quickly or add it just before serving.  
[USER] The user expressed a love for experimenting with different ingredients and asked for other add-ons for the salsa.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided several suggestions for add-ons: diced mango, pineapple, charred corn, black beans, diced cucumber, diced bell peppers, and roasted tomatillos.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised that adding more ingredients will change the flavor and texture of the salsa, suggesting to experiment with small batches.  
[USER] The user expressed enthusiasm for the suggestions and stated they would try adding diced mango and corn to their salsa next time.
